scope.en: UC Davis School of Medicine (SOM) baseline: Students are expected to author coursework independently unless instructed; closed-book assessment AI use is prohibited unless written permission is granted; external GenAI tools cannot generate patient documentation except as outlined in UC Davis Health policy; campus-wide student LLM licensing remains an unverified gap.
scope.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院（SOM）基准：学生须独立完成课业，有明确教学要求除外；闭卷考核严禁使用AI，经教师或课程主管书面许可除外；严禁使用外部AI生成患者诊疗记录，符合健康系统政策除外；全校统一人工智能许可待核验。

do.zh: 独立完成医学院课业作业。
经许可使用AI须透明披露。

dont.en: No AI in closed-book exams unless permitted.
dont.zh: 闭卷考试严禁AI，书面批准除外。

dont.en: No patient records in external AI unless authorized.
dont.zh: 严禁生成患者诊疗记录，政策允许除外。

scope.en: UC Davis School of Medicine (SOM) baseline: Students are expected to author coursework independently unless instructed; closed-book assessment AI use is prohibited unless written permission is granted; external GenAI tools cannot generate patient documentation except as outlined in UC Davis Health policy; campus-wide student LLM licensing remains an unverified gap.
scope.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院（SOM）基准：学生须独立完成课业，有明确教学要求除外；闭卷考核严禁使用AI，经教师或课程主管书面许可除外；严禁使用外部AI生成患者诊疗记录，符合健康系统政策除外；全校统一人工智能许可待核验。

coursework.en: UC Davis School of Medicine expects students to independently author all written assignments. Where specific assignments require or permit AI, students must follow faculty instructions.
coursework.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院要求学生独立撰写所有书面作业；具体作业要求或允许使用AI时，学生必须遵循教师指示。
coursework.meaningZh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院 (SOM)

exams.en: In UC Davis School of Medicine examinations, using generative AI tools to research or produce answers for closed-book assessments is prohibited unless faculty or course leadership grants written permission.
exams.zh: 在加州大学戴维斯分校医学院（SOM）考试中，严禁在闭卷考核中使用生成式AI工具检索或生成答案，教师或课程领导明确书面批准除外。
exams.meaningZh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院 (SOM)

disclosure.en: Under UC Davis School of Medicine coursework policy, any permitted use of generative AI tools must be transparently disclosed in submissions, detailing the specific tool utilized and the nature of its contribution.
disclosure.zh: 依据加州大学戴维斯分校医学院（SOM）课业规范，经许可使用生成式AI工具须在提交作业中透明披露，明确说明所用工具类型及贡献性质。
disclosure.meaningEn: UC Davis School of Medicine coursework AI disclosure standards
disclosure.meaningZh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院课业AI使用披露标准

privacy_data.en: UC Davis School of Medicine students are not permitted to use external GenAI tools to generate patient care documentation, except as outlined in UC Davis Health policy.
privacy_data.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院（SOM）学生不得使用外部生成式AI工具生成患者诊疗记录，经加州大学戴维斯分校健康医疗政策明确允许的环境除外。
privacy_data.meaningEn: UC Davis School of Medicine patient documentation and privacy restrictions
privacy_data.meaningZh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院患者诊疗记录与隐私限制

approved_tools.en: UC Davis provides guidance on campus technology access; centralized institutional licensing for students across all commercial LLMs remains an unverified gap.
approved_tools.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校提供校园技术使用指引；面向学生的商用大模型统一校级许可属于未核实政策缺口。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Campus Aggie AI directory and syllabus specifications
approved_tools.meaningZh: 校园Aggie AI目录与各科大纲限定

research_publication.en: UC Davis Library provides evolving citation recommendations for generative AI exchanges; formal campus-wide mandatory publication citation rules remain an unverified gap.
research_publication.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校图书馆提供动态更新的生成式AI引用建议；全校统一的强制性学术出版引用规则属于未核实政策缺口。
research_publication.meaningEn: UC Davis Library citation best practices
research_publication.meaningZh: 图书馆引注与学术成果最佳实践

academic_integrity.en: UC Davis School of Medicine students are responsible for verifying the accuracy and reliability of GenAI content and are accountable for errors or misinformation in their work.
academic_integrity.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院（SOM）学生须核实生成式AI信息的准确性与可靠性，并对纳入本人作品的错误或误导信息负责。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: UC Davis School of Medicine student verification and accuracy accountability
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院学生内容核实与准确性责任

teaching_guidance.en: In UC Davis School of Medicine coursework, when assignments incorporate AI technologies, students must strictly observe all procedural instructions provided by faculty.
teaching_guidance.zh: 在加州大学戴维斯分校医学院（SOM）课程中，当作业明确引入AI技术时，学生必须严格遵守主讲教师设定的所有操作指引。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: UC Davis School of Medicine faculty instruction and assessment guidelines
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 加州大学戴维斯分校医学院教学与考核指引

security_procurement.en: Campus-wide procurement evaluations and enterprise license agreements for all commercial Aggie AI tools were not verified in local crawl extractions.
security_procurement.zh: Aggie AI所涉全部商业工具的校级采购评估与企业级许可协议未在本地抓取提取物中核实。

do.en: The School of Medicine expects students to independently author all written assignments.
do.zh: 医学院期望学生独立撰写所有书面作业。

do.en: Disclose any permitted generative AI use transparently in coursework, detailing the tool and contribution.
do.zh: 在经许可使用AI的课业中进行透明披露，详述所用工具及对作品的具体贡献性质。

dont.en: Do not use GenAI to research or generate answers in School of Medicine closed-book assessments unless faculty or course leadership grants written permission.
dont.zh: 医学院闭卷考核中，未经教师或课程负责人书面许可，不要使用生成式AI检索或生成答案。

dont.en: Do not use external GenAI tools to generate patient care documentation except as authorized under UC Davis Health policy.
dont.zh: 切勿使用外部生成式AI工具生成患者诊疗记录、病历或护理计划，符合健康医疗政策允许的除外。
